The user is **Jim Freeman** <[redacted-email]>, the maintainer of this XBoing
modernization. Git may show him as "J F" or "J Freeman"; both are him.

**Justin C. Kibell** is a different person — the original author of XBoing
(1993–1996, Xlib/XPM on Sun and SGI workstations). He is represented in this
repo by the `jck` agent persona, and credited in `debian/copyright`
(`Files: original/*`, `Copyright: 1993-1996 Justin C. Kibell`) and by the
in-game "Justin"/"Kibell" credit bitmaps on the presents screen.

Never write "Justin Freeman" — it is a conflation of the two, not anyone's
name. That exact error had been sitting in the shipped packaging metadata
(`debian/control` Maintainer, `debian/copyright` Upstream-Contact, and two
`debian/changelog` signatures) until it was corrected on 2026-09-07.

Bare "Justin" in `src/`, `docs/`, and `include/` refers to Kibell.
